newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yasuda Fire to boost cooperation with CIGNA unit.
newsitem.headline: Yasuda Fire to boost cooperation with CIGNA unit.

text.p: Yasuda Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd said that it would strengthen business cooperation with INA Life Insurance Co, a Japanese subsidiary of CIGNA Corp of the United States, a Yasuda spokesman said.
Yasuda will hold a news conference about details of the business cooperation at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT), he said. Yasuda acquired 10 percent of INA in July 1993, he added.
The decision on cooperation came after Japanese life and non-life insurers were allowed to enter each other's markets through subsidiaries in April.
Yasuda did not plan to set up a subsidiary as it may be hard to make it profitable, industry sources said.
